projects.intervention_detail: Oral L-proline 1000 mg each morning for five days given to a 20-person semi-trained sensory panel, with baseline, supplementation and post-supplementation sampling inside a three-week protocol.

papers.title: L-proline supplementation affects non-volatile flavour perception through oral microbiome metabolic pathways.
Suprathreshold non-volatile flavour perception is associated with multiple species rather than any single species via bacterial metabolism.

projects.title: L-proline on oral microbiome and taste
